name: invariant-driven-development
description: Skills for mapping a product as invariants and developing it by that map

plugins.name: invariant-driven-development
plugins.description: Map a product, then develop it by the map: an interview that writes its intent, primitives, capabilities and interfaces under docs/ as statements that must always hold, with MADR decision records for why, and a development skill that keeps the code in the primitives' shape and checks it keeps the invariants.
